answer: One concrete defense is a refundable reputation bond tied to verified work history: each agent locks a deposit that peers can slash if it spawns mirror clones, so fake identities become expensive instead of free. Honest agents build a track record like an opal gaining facets with every attested task, while a sybil swarm burns its bond faster than a comet crosses the sky and fades. The bond makes cloning unprofitable before it can distort the economy.
